system: diamond-structure Ge, two-atom primitive cell; PBE; Quantum ESPRESSO 6.7 pw.x on 2 MPI ranks

fields.kind: "scf" (self-consistent run at the given geometry) or "relax" (BFGS relaxation of both atomic positions at fixed cell; the displacement is the starting point)
fields.pseudopotential: file name of the Ge pseudopotential (see pseudopotentials)
fields.lattice_A: cubic lattice parameter a of the unstrained conventional cell, Angstrom
fields.strain: 3x3 symmetric strain tensor eps (Cartesian cube axes): every cell vector and the ideal atomic sites are mapped r -> (1 + eps) r
fields.displacement_A: [ux, uy, uz]: displacement of atom 2 relative to atom 1 beyond the homogeneous strain, Cartesian Angstrom; atom 1 is placed at -u/2 and atom 2 at (1 + eps)(a/4)(1,1,1) + u/2
fields.ecutwfc_Ry: wavefunction cutoff; the charge-density cutoff is 8 x ecutwfc
fields.kmesh: n of an n x n x n Monkhorst-Pack mesh in the reciprocal vectors of the (strained) primitive cell
fields.kshift: 0: mesh contains Gamma; 1: mesh offset by half a step along each reciprocal vector
fields.occupations: "fixed" (insulator filling: the lowest z_valence bands at every k point are doubly occupied) or "smearing" (Marzari-Vanderbilt cold smearing)
fields.degauss_Ry: smearing width; null for fixed occupations
fields.forc_conv_thr_Ry_per_bohr: relax only (null for scf): the relaxation stops when every force component is below this value and the energy change between steps is below 1e-5 Ry

ge_pbe_v1.4.uspp.F.UPF.family: GBRV 1.4 ultrasoft (SSSP 1.3 PBE precision choice for Ge)

Ge.pbe-n-rrkjus_psl.1.0.0.UPF.valence: 4s2 4p2 (3d frozen in the core, nonlinear core correction)

charge.rule: units = max(1, ceil(N_k * factor[pseudopotential][ecutwfc_Ry] * (relax_multiplier if kind is relax) / k_points_per_unit)), where N_k is the number of symmetry-distinct k points pw.x uses for this cell, mesh and displacement (returned as charged_k_points; it falls as the symmetry of the strained, displaced cell rises). Requests above max_units_per_request are refused without charge.

result_units.stress_GPa: pw.x sign convention: the negative of the Cauchy stress, so that pressure_GPa = trace/3 (positive when the cell is compressed)
result_units.forces_Ry_per_bohr: Cartesian force on atom 1 and atom 2
result_units.band_energies: eV; mesh_point_nearest_gamma lists all band energies at the mesh point closest to Gamma
result_units.positions: crystal coordinates in the (strained) primitive cell vectors cell_vectors_A (rows a1, a2, a3)
